Turn the English expectation into independently assessable criteria for the assistant answer. Describe observable answer behavior; acknowledgement alone does not prove persistence. Use the expectation as written; do not add requirements. Return JSON {"criteria":["..."]}.
User: Actually, cancel pizza tomorrow. I don't feel like going.
Expectation: Ask which of the two outings I mean, without claiming either has been cancelled.

message.content: {"criteria":["The answer asks which of the two outings the user means","The answer does not claim that either outing has been cancelled"]}
